summary: A single-branch continuation clone can have a freshly fetched origin/main ref but no main fetch mapping; managed worktree creation then fails when configuring main tracking after100%checkout.

Root repaired the additive main fetch mapping, preserved the prior mapping, fetched successfully, and retried the failed creation only after no failed worktree/thread remained. Actual new Hotube thread01a14e56-6069-7c81-ad3e-afed9c28bb5f is active.
